 Bigg Boss 20: Who Will Make It to the Top Five? ScoutOP, Qazi Touqeer, Yung DSA Among Strong Contenders
 As Bigg Boss 20 approaches its grand finale, viewers are already predicting which contestants will make it to the top five. ScoutOP, Qazi Touqeer, Yung DSA, Mahhi Vij and Kanika Mann are among the names gaining attention, with three contestants believed to have a strong chance of securing their places.
 Parthana Bora 
 13 Nov 2026 
 17:31
 IST Follow Us
 New Update The competition inside the Bigg Boss 20 house is getting more intense as the reality show moves closer to its grand finale, which is likely to take place by mid-December. Hosted by Bollywood superstar Salman Khan, the show has continued to attract viewers and generate considerable buzz across the country. 
 With the finale approaching, discussions around the potential finalists have gained momentum. ScoutOP, Qazi Touqeer, Yung DSA, Mahhi Vij and Kanika Mann are currently among the five contestants viewers expect to see in the final lineup. While ScoutOP, Qazi Touqeer and Yung DSA are considered strong contenders, their actual positions will depend on how the competition unfolds. 
 Bigg Boss 20: Meet the Five Contestants Likely to Make It to the Top Five 
 1. Yung DSA 
 Rapper Yung DSA, whose real name is Harsh Vijay Machare, has emerged as one of the talked-about contestants of Bigg Boss 20. His journey in the house has been marked by growing popularity on social media, a captaincy victory and several high-profile disagreements with fellow contestants. 
 His growing fan following outside the house has added to his popularity, making him one of the strong contenders for a place in the top five. 
 View this post on Instagram 
 2. Mahhi Vij 
 Actress Mahhi Vij entered Bigg Boss 20 on September 6, 2026, as one of the show's 16 original contestants. Known for her outspoken nature and strong personality, she has managed to remain a prominent presence inside the house. 
 From taking a competitive approach to kitchen duties to becoming an emotional support for some housemates, Mahhi's journey has featured several interesting moments. However, her strong opinions have also led to disagreements with other contestants. 
 View this post on Instagram 
 3. ScoutOP 
 Tanmay Singh, popularly known as ScoutOP or Sc0ut, is among the prominent contestants of Bigg Boss 20. The Indian esports athlete, streamer and content creator entered the Salman Khan-hosted reality show in September 2026. 
 His time inside the house has been marked by emotional outbursts, heated rivalries and disciplinary action. Despite the controversies surrounding his gameplay, ScoutOP continues to enjoy a considerable fan following outside the house, strengthening his chances of making it to the top five. 
 View this post on Instagram 
 4. Qazi Touqeer 
 Singer and television personality Qazi Touqeer has made a return to mainstream reality television with Bigg Boss 20. He first rose to nationwide fame after winning the inaugural season of Fame Gurukul in 2005. 
 Nearly two decades after his television breakthrough, Qazi's participation in Bigg Boss has brought him back into the spotlight. His existing popularity and fan base have made him one of the contestants viewers are predicting to reach the grand finale. 
 View this post on Instagram 
 5. Kanika Mann 
 Actress Kanika Mann entered Bigg Boss 20 as the first contestant of the season. The show premiered on September 6, 2026, and she was given the special title of Puppet Master on the opening day. 
 Known for her work in television and Punjabi films, Kanika has been among the contestants attracting attention throughout the season. Her gameplay and performance in the coming weeks will be crucial in determining whether she can secure a place among the finalists. 
 View this post on Instagram 
 Who Are the Other Contestants in the Bigg Boss 20 House? 
 Apart from the five names being discussed as potential finalists, other contestants currently competing in the Bigg Boss 20 house include Love Gill, Manish, Uditi Singh and Amrapali. 
 With the competition entering a crucial phase, every task, nomination and elimination could change the expected top-five lineup.  
 Conclusion 
 With Bigg Boss 20 moving towards its anticipated grand finale in mid-December, the race for the top five spots is becoming increasingly interesting. ScoutOP, Qazi Touqeer, Yung DSA, Mahhi Vij and Kanika Mann are among the names viewers are predicting to make the cut. 
 While ScoutOP, Qazi Touqeer and Yung DSA are considered strong contenders because of their fan following, nothing is final yet. Whether these five contestants actually make it to the grand finale remains to be seen.
